title: The Revolution of 1930 and the Vargas era
summary: The Old Republic was run by an alliance of São Paulo and Minas Gerais that passed the presidency between them. In 1929 Washington Luís broke the arrangement by naming a second paulista as his successor; Minas Gerais, Rio Grande do Sul and Paraíba answered with a Liberal Alliance behind Getúlio Vargas, called the March 1930 election fraudulent, and rose on 3 October after the assassination of Vargas’s running mate. The armed insurrection ended the four-decade oligarchy, put Vargas in the presidency in place of the man who had won, and began the fifteen years of his rule.

actors.note: the armed insurrection ended the Old Republic and put Vargas in the presidency for fifteen years
